items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The transcript identifies the interviewee as 'Zutty Singleton' and the person to judge as 'Zutto'. The interviewer uses 'Zutto' to address the interviewee directly (e.g., 'we have to go back now Zutto', 'Because Zutto was never A gamble R').

ctx.x: Yes, he's still up in Harlem because he just became a lush.
